sessions.title: A Speaking about beliefs and opinions
sessions.description_vi: Nói về niềm tin và ý kiến.
sessions.value:
# Talking about beliefs and opinions

## A Speaking about beliefs and opinions

- I **firmly believe** that young people should have the right to vote at 16.
- I **share your opinion** on the issue of hunting. I’m a **great believer** in animals’ rights.
- **Contrary to popular belief**, it is not true that blondes are dumb.
- We **have reason to believe** that you witnessed the accident.
- We are **poles apart** in our attitudes to life.
- It’s **a matter of opinion** whether men are better drivers than women.
- I had **a difference of opinion** with my brother.
- I’ve got **a sneaking suspicion** you may be right.

1 what many people think
2 are completely different
3 disagreement
4 I’m beginning to think

sessions.title: B More formal ways of discussing beliefs
sessions.description_vi: Các cách nói trang trọng hơn để thảo luận về niềm tin.
sessions.value:
## B More formal ways of discussing beliefs

The writer seems to **make assumptions** based on an **unshakeable belief** in the superiority of her own value system. She seems to be unaware of the extent to which her own set of beliefs has **coloured her judgement**. Her research **leads her to conclude** that military action was justified. However, her evidence is based on one single document and **attaches too much importance** to this. I do not **trust her judgement**. Moreover, other documents **cast doubt** on her conclusions. **Opinions on the issue are divided** and my own **considered opinion** is that the writer is not to be trusted. I have **serious misgivings** about her research and I have **doubts** about the accuracy of some of her facts.

1 thinks or says things are true without enough evidence
2 affected her judgement
3 suggest something may be wrong with
4 people have different opinions
5 opinion after much thought
6 I have serious doubts about

content_items.value:
| collocation                               | comment                                                      |
| ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| I hope you’ll come to my party.           | NOT wish                                                     |
| They’ve given up hope of any survivors.   | NOT the hope                                                 |
| We need to think hard about this problem. | NOT consider hard – could be consider this problem carefully |
| I wish they would just leave me alone.    | NOT let                                                      |
| Many people hold the view/opinion that …  | NOT meaning                                                  |
| He has strong opinions on many subjects.  | NOT heavy or big                                             |

image.value: A person strongly holding a belief

senses.definition_vi: Tin tưởng mạnh mẽ vào điều gì đó.
examples: I **firmly believe** that young people should have the right to vote at 16.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả một niềm tin chắc chắn, không lay chuyển.

use_prompts.question: Should the voting age be lowered to sixteen?
Should university education be free?
Should individuals or governments do more to protect the environment?

dictation.text: I firmly believe that education should be free.

paraphrase.source: I am completely sure that young people should be allowed to vote at 16.
paraphrase.model: I firmly believe that young people should have the right to vote at 16.

paraphrase.source: I strongly think that everyone has a duty to recycle.
paraphrase.model: I firmly believe that everyone has a duty to recycle.

image.value: Two people agreeing on a topic

senses.definition_vi: Đồng ý với quan điểm của người khác.
examples: I **share your opinion** on the issue of hunting.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để thể hiện sự đồng tình với ý kiến của ai đó.

use_prompts.question: Do you agree that hunting animals for sport should be banned?
Some say homework is a waste of time; do you agree?
Do you agree that working from home is more productive?

dictation.text: I share your opinion about the new rules.

paraphrase.source: I agree with you on the issue of hunting.
paraphrase.model: I share your opinion on the issue of hunting.

paraphrase.source: I think the same as you about working from home.
paraphrase.model: I share your opinion about working from home.

image.value: Someone who strongly supports a cause

senses.definition_vi: Người tin tưởng mạnh mẽ vào điều gì đó hoặc ủng hộ mạnh mẽ một ý tưởng/nguyên tắc.
examples: I’m a **great believer** in animals’ rights.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Nhấn mạnh sự tin tưởng hoặc ủng hộ mạnh mẽ.

use_prompts.question: Do you think regular exercise is the key to a long life?
Is learning by doing better than learning from books?
Should animals have the same rights as people?

dictation.text: My father is a great believer in hard work.

paraphrase.source: I strongly support the idea of animals' rights.
paraphrase.model: I'm a great believer in animals' rights.

paraphrase.source: My grandmother strongly believes that fresh air is good for you.
paraphrase.model: My grandmother is a great believer in fresh air.

image.value: A surprising fact that contradicts common assumptions

senses.definition_vi: Trái với niềm tin phổ biến của nhiều người.
examples: **Contrary to popular belief**, it is not true that blondes are dumb.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để giới thiệu một thông tin hoặc sự thật khác với những gì đa số mọi người nghĩ.

use_prompts.question: Is eating fat really bad for your health?
Do clever students always get the best jobs?
What common ideas about your country are actually wrong?

dictation.text: Contrary to popular belief, bats are not blind.

paraphrase.source: Many people think blondes are less intelligent, but this is not true.
paraphrase.model: Contrary to popular belief, blondes are not less intelligent.

paraphrase.source: Most people think that eating fat makes you fat, but this is wrong.
paraphrase.model: Contrary to popular belief, eating fat does not always make you fat.

image.value: Someone looking thoughtful with evidence

senses.definition_vi: Có cơ sở hoặc lý do để tin rằng điều gì đó là đúng.
examples: We **have reason to believe** that you witnessed the accident.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Cho thấy có bằng chứng hoặc dấu hiệu để đưa ra một kết luận.

use_prompts.question: How should the police deal with witnesses to a crime?
Do you think house prices will keep rising?
Is there evidence that climate change is getting worse?

dictation.text: We have reason to believe that he is lying.

paraphrase.source: We think, based on evidence, that you saw the accident.
paraphrase.model: We have reason to believe that you witnessed the accident.

paraphrase.source: Scientists have evidence suggesting that sea levels will rise faster.
paraphrase.model: Scientists have reason to believe that sea levels will rise faster.

image.value: Two very different objects far from each other

senses.definition_vi: Hoàn toàn khác biệt, trái ngược nhau.
examples: We are **poles apart** in our attitudes to life.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để mô tả sự khác biệt lớn hoặc hoàn toàn trái ngược về quan điểm, thái độ, v.v.

use_prompts.question: Do you and your siblings have similar personalities?
Are young and old people's views on technology very different?
How different are city and country lifestyles in your country?

dictation.text: My brother and I are poles apart.

paraphrase.source: We have completely different attitudes to life.
paraphrase.model: We are poles apart in our attitudes to life.

paraphrase.source: The two political parties have totally opposite views on taxes.
paraphrase.model: The two political parties are poles apart on taxes.

image.value: A question mark over two different viewpoints

senses.definition_vi: Là vấn đề của ý kiến cá nhân, không có câu trả lời đúng hay sai tuyệt đối.
examples: It’s **a matter of opinion** whether men are better drivers than women.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để chỉ ra rằng một vấn đề có thể có nhiều quan điểm khác nhau và không có sự thật khách quan.

use_prompts.question: Are men better drivers than women?
Is modern art really art?
Is Vietnamese food the best in the world?

dictation.text: Good music is a matter of opinion.

paraphrase.source: Whether men drive better than women depends on what each person thinks.
paraphrase.model: It's a matter of opinion whether men are better drivers than women.

paraphrase.source: There is no right answer about whether modern art is beautiful; people just think differently.
paraphrase.model: Whether modern art is beautiful is a matter of opinion.

image.value: Two people looking at each other with disagreement

senses.definition_vi: Sự bất đồng, không cùng quan điểm.
examples: I had **a difference of opinion** with my brother.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Chỉ sự không thống nhất về ý kiến giữa hai hoặc nhiều người.

use_prompts.question: How do you handle disagreements with family members?
What should colleagues do when they disagree about a project?
Why do generations often disagree about politics?

dictation.text: I had a difference of opinion with my brother.

paraphrase.source: My brother and I disagreed about something.
paraphrase.model: I had a difference of opinion with my brother.

paraphrase.source: My manager and I did not agree about the budget.
paraphrase.model: My manager and I had a difference of opinion about the budget.

image.value: A person looking slightly suspicious

senses.definition_vi: Một sự nghi ngờ thầm kín, thường là không chắc chắn nhưng có cảm giác là đúng.
examples: I’ve got **a sneaking suspicion** you may be right.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả một cảm giác mơ hồ hoặc nghi ngờ nhẹ rằng điều gì đó có thể đúng, mặc dù không có bằng chứng rõ ràng.

use_prompts.question: Have you ever felt something was wrong at work without proof?
Can parents tell when their children are hiding something?
Do you trust everything you read in the news?

dictation.text: I have a sneaking suspicion that he is lying.

paraphrase.source: I secretly think that you may be right.
paraphrase.model: I've got a sneaking suspicion you may be right.

paraphrase.source: I quietly suspect that some online news stories are not true.
paraphrase.model: I have a sneaking suspicion that some online news stories are not true.

image.value: A person jumping to conclusions

senses.definition_vi: Cho rằng điều gì đó là đúng mà không có bằng chứng hoặc sự xem xét cẩn thận.
examples: The writer seems to **make assumptions** based on an unshakeable belief in the superiority of her own value system.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường mang nghĩa tiêu cực, chỉ việc đưa ra kết luận vội vàng hoặc dựa trên suy đoán.

use_prompts.question: Why do people judge others by their appearance?
Why should students check facts before writing an essay?
What mistakes do managers make when hiring staff?

dictation.text: We should not make assumptions about other people.

paraphrase.source: The writer seems to think things are true without checking them.
paraphrase.model: The writer seems to make assumptions without checking them.

paraphrase.source: People often judge strangers without knowing anything about them.
paraphrase.model: People often make assumptions about strangers without knowing anything about them.

image.value: A strong, solid foundation representing belief

senses.definition_vi: Niềm tin vững chắc, không thể lay chuyển.
examples: The writer seems to make assumptions based on an **unshakeable belief** in the superiority of her own value system.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Nhấn mạnh sự kiên định và chắc chắn của niềm tin.

use_prompts.question: How important is religion to people in your country?
What helps champions keep going after defeats?
Why do some people refuse to change their political views?

dictation.text: She has an unshakeable belief in her own ability.

paraphrase.source: The writer is completely sure that her own values are better than others'.
paraphrase.model: The writer has an unshakeable belief in the superiority of her own values.

paraphrase.source: Champions never stop believing that they will win.
paraphrase.model: Champions have an unshakeable belief that they will win.

image.value: A person's judgment being influenced by bias

senses.definition_vi: Ảnh hưởng đến cách đánh giá hoặc phán đoán của ai đó, thường là theo hướng tiêu cực hoặc thiên vị.
examples: She seems to be unaware of the extent to which her own set of beliefs has **coloured her judgement**.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Cho thấy rằng một yếu tố nào đó (như niềm tin, cảm xúc) đã làm sai lệch khả năng đưa ra quyết định khách quan.

use_prompts.question: Can a journalist's personal views affect their reporting?
Can personal feelings affect a manager's decisions?
Should judges with strong political views decide important cases?

dictation.text: Her anger coloured her judgement of the situation.

paraphrase.source: Her own beliefs have influenced the way she judges things.
paraphrase.model: Her own beliefs have coloured her judgement.

paraphrase.source: Her friendship with the candidate affected how fairly she decided.
paraphrase.model: Her friendship with the candidate coloured her judgement.

image.value: A path leading to a final decision

senses.definition_vi: Dẫn đến kết luận rằng điều gì đó là đúng.
examples: Her research **leads her to conclude** that military action was justified.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Chỉ ra rằng các bằng chứng hoặc thông tin đã dẫn đến một kết luận cụ thể.

use_prompts.question: How should researchers reach their conclusions?
What might make a doctor decide a patient needs surgery?
How do judges decide whether someone is guilty?

dictation.text: The evidence leads her to conclude that he is guilty.

paraphrase.source: Because of her research, she decides that military action was justified.
paraphrase.model: Her research leads her to conclude that military action was justified.

paraphrase.source: The test results make the doctor think that the patient needs surgery.
paraphrase.model: The test results lead her to conclude that the patient needs surgery.

image.value: A scale heavily tilted towards one side

senses.definition_vi: Đánh giá quá cao tầm quan trọng của một điều gì đó.
examples: Her evidence is based on one single document and **attaches too much importance** to this.
grammar_patterns: attach too much importance to something
senses.usage_notes_vi: Cho thấy sự nhấn mạnh không cần thiết hoặc quá mức vào một yếu tố nào đó.

use_prompts.question: Do schools focus too much on exam results?
Do people care too much about appearance?
Do the media give celebrities too much attention?

dictation.text: He attaches too much importance to money.

paraphrase.source: Her evidence is based on one document, and she thinks it is far more important than it is.
paraphrase.model: Her evidence is based on one document, and she attaches too much importance to it.

paraphrase.source: Society considers appearance far more important than it really is.
paraphrase.model: Society attaches too much importance to appearance.

image.value: A person confidently making a decision

senses.definition_vi: Tin tưởng vào khả năng đưa ra quyết định hoặc đánh giá đúng đắn của ai đó.
examples: I do not **trust her judgement**.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thể hiện sự tin tưởng vào năng lực phán đoán của một người.

use_prompts.question: What makes a good manager?
Whose advice do you follow when you make big decisions?
Should patients always follow their doctor's advice?

dictation.text: I trust her judgement about people.

paraphrase.source: I do not believe she makes good decisions.
paraphrase.model: I do not trust her judgement.

paraphrase.source: My mother always gives good advice, so I believe her decisions are right.
paraphrase.model: My mother always gives good advice, so I trust her judgement.

image.value: A shadow of doubt over something

senses.definition_vi: Gây ra sự nghi ngờ hoặc làm cho điều gì đó trở nên không chắc chắn.
examples: Moreover, other documents **cast doubt** on her conclusions.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để chỉ ra rằng có những yếu tố làm lung lay hoặc nghi ngờ tính đúng đắn của một điều gì đó.

use_prompts.question: How should we treat new research about diets?
How can new evidence change public opinion about a news story?
What can make people question a court decision?

dictation.text: New evidence cast doubt on his story.

paraphrase.source: Other documents make her conclusions seem uncertain.
paraphrase.model: Other documents cast doubt on her conclusions.

paraphrase.source: The new study makes people question whether the diet works.
paraphrase.model: The new study casts doubt on whether the diet works.

opinions_on_the_issue_are_divided.word: Opinions on the issue are divided

image.value: Two groups of people with different signs

senses.definition_vi: Mọi người có những ý kiến khác nhau về một vấn đề.
examples: **Opinions on the issue are divided** and my own considered opinion is that the writer is not to be trusted.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả tình trạng có nhiều quan điểm trái chiều về một chủ đề.

use_prompts.question: Do people in your country agree about the death penalty?
Is artificial intelligence good or bad for society?
Should mobile phones be banned in schools?

dictation.target: Opinions on the issue are divided
dictation.text: Opinions on the issue are divided among teachers.

paraphrase.target: Opinions on the issue are divided
paraphrase.source: People disagree about this question, and I think the writer is not to be trusted.
paraphrase.model: Opinions on the issue are divided, and I think the writer is not to be trusted.

paraphrase.target: Opinions on the issue are divided
paraphrase.source: People have very different views about banning phones in schools.
paraphrase.model: Opinions on the issue of banning phones in schools are divided.

image.value: A person thinking deeply about something

senses.definition_vi: Ý kiến đã được suy nghĩ kỹ lưỡng, cẩn thận.
examples: my own **considered opinion** is that the writer is not to be trusted.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Nhấn mạnh rằng ý kiến đưa ra là kết quả của sự cân nhắc và suy nghĩ kỹ lưỡng.

use_prompts.question: Should the government raise taxes on sugary drinks?
Is online learning as good as classroom learning?
Can we trust social media as a news source?

dictation.text: My considered opinion is that the plan will fail.

paraphrase.source: After thinking about it carefully, I believe the writer is not to be trusted.
paraphrase.model: My considered opinion is that the writer is not to be trusted.

paraphrase.source: After much careful thought, I believe online learning cannot replace teachers.
paraphrase.model: My considered opinion is that online learning cannot replace teachers.

image.value: A person looking worried or uncertain

senses.definition_vi: Sự nghi ngờ hoặc lo lắng nghiêm trọng về điều gì đó.
examples: I have **serious misgivings** about her research.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả sự lo ngại sâu sắc hoặc nghi ngờ về tính đúng đắn, an toàn hoặc hiệu quả của một kế hoạch, hành động hoặc ý tưởng.

use_prompts.question: Are you worried about self-driving cars?
How do employees feel about big changes in their company?
Should new airports be built near cities?

dictation.text: I have serious misgivings about the new plan.

paraphrase.source: I have strong doubts about her research.
paraphrase.model: I have serious misgivings about her research.

paraphrase.source: Many residents are very worried about the new airport.
paraphrase.model: Many residents have serious misgivings about the new airport.

image.value: A question mark hovering over a statement

senses.definition_vi: Sự không chắc chắn hoặc nghi ngờ về điều gì đó.
examples: I have **doubts** about the accuracy of some of her facts.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thể hiện sự thiếu tin tưởng hoặc không chắc chắn về tính đúng đắn hoặc sự thật của một điều gì đó.

use_prompts.question: Do you always believe news reports?
How do you feel before starting a new job?
Is a university degree still worth the cost?

dictation.text: I have doubts about his story.

paraphrase.source: I am not sure that some of her facts are accurate.
paraphrase.model: I have doubts about the accuracy of some of her facts.

paraphrase.source: Many young people are uncertain whether a degree is worth the cost.
paraphrase.model: Many young people have doubts about whether a degree is worth the cost.
